items.title: 67251_Chuck Green oral history interview
items.q: my Uncle named Saul -- he would lecture me before

ctx.x: And she said, "Come here and get up in the chair," and she set me up in a high -- what do you call it -- baby chair, you know. "Yes, ma'am," you see. I got up there, you know, and she said, "My, my," and she went back towards the stove, you know, whenever I see my mother going towards the stove I would get happy, you see, because I knew I was going to get a piece offie or some goodies fromsomewhere, you know. So, I kept on, and eventually my Daddy would come home, you know. Well, I was happy again, see, because I…

I would arrive at school, on the way to kindergarten, you know. And, so, I had something nice to say to my parents, my Daddy. Of course, I would never -- I was an only child and I would never know when I was going to get asked a question, you know. But if one would ask a question, you know, if the other one didn't answer the question that that one would ask, then I would have to answer it, you see. But sometimes I would get two questions to answer, so I figured, well, now I've got them. I've got them now. I'm…
